title: Black Rock Forest balloon mapping and field GIS
description: Students in three Columbia GIS courses combined balloon imagery with ground observations.
sourceNote: Published captions and camera metadata date the trip to October 28, 2017. Balloon imagery preceded the later drone work; infrared colors are not calibrated NDVI.

title: SDEV3450 Callicoon field exercise
description: Students connected field observations with drone mapping and jointly developed spatial analyses, including contour and shaded-relief layouts.
sourceNote: The published account dates the exercise April 4–5, 2022. Exact photograph days and independent map accuracy are not established.

title: Collaborative mapping session at Lamont
description: Colleagues discussed research questions and collected drone imagery at Lamont.
sourceNote: Camera metadata dates the photographs to June 7, 2022. The session is not assigned to a course.

title: SDEV3450 field workshop
description: SDEV3450 students and instructors beside drone equipment during a Lamont field session.
sourceNote: Camera metadata and the course collection date the session to January 30, 2023. Mapped products have their own processing dates.

title: SDEV3450 equipment session
description: Students and instructors during an indoor SDEV3450 equipment session.

title: NSF REU/RET Drones and GIS workshop
description: Students and educators took part in a CIESIN workshop led by Kytt MacManus and Greg Yetman, with Joshua Fisher coordinating the group. Photographs and mission products document the field and spatial-data context.
sourceNote: July 14, 2023 field photographs and mission products document the NSF REU/RET workshop. Photographs do not measure learning outcomes.

title: SDEV4650 field-data workshop at Lamont
description: The Building Climate Justice workshop covered flight safety, Field Maps observations and drone imagery. Visible-light, thermal and 3D products accompany the activity.
sourceNote: SiteScan dates these products to October 11, 2023. Thermal colors are qualitative; image counts do not establish calibration.

title: Staten Island rooftop fieldwork
description: Students and community partners conducted a rooftop drone session at 60 Hannah Street. The collection includes field photographs, survey imagery and a firehouse reconstruction.
sourceNote: Camera and mission dates identify December 2, 2023. A different date in the project label is not the acquisition date.

title: SDEV3450 winter field workshop
description: SDEV3450 convened at Lamont for fieldwork involving drone-camera observations. The winter group photograph is shown with related optical, thermal and reconstruction mission displays.
sourceNote: February 19, 2024 camera and mission dates identify the SDEV3450 session. Photographs and products have different observational roles.

title: Building Climate Justice drone training
description: Building Climate Justice students practiced drone operations at Lamont, including mission planning relevant to later South Bronx work.
sourceNote: Camera metadata dates these photographs to October 16, 2024; some folder labels use a different date.

title: SDEV3450 visible-light and thermal demonstration
description: A SDEV3450 class visit combined a drone demonstration with visible-light and thermal group observations. The selected pair shares a camera timestamp of 10:22:02.
sourceNote: The visible and thermal pair share March 5, 2025 at 10:22:02 in camera metadata. Thermal colors have no calibrated temperature scale here.

title: William Paterson campus tree-mapping workshop
description: Nicole Davi hosted a workshop connecting Field Maps tree observations with drone imagery and elevation products.
sourceNote: The visible and thermal originals share March 11, 2025 at 15:10:48 in camera metadata. Public product layers retain their separate processing context.

title: NYESTA educators: field data and drone observations
description: Kytt MacManus and Juan F. Martinez contributed a presentation to the New York State Earth Science Teachers Association conference visit. The drone demonstration produced visible-light and thermal group photographs.
sourceNote: August 5, 2025 camera metadata identifies the NYESTA field demonstration. Thermal colors are qualitative.

title: SDEV4650 drone operations workshop
description: SDEV4650 students attended a drone operations workshop at Lamont. Group, visible-light and thermal photographs document the operation area and campus context.
sourceNote: October 15, 2025 camera dates identify the SDEV4650 field collection. It is distinct from the October 16, 2024 session.

title: North Shore community fieldwork
description: Ground and drone photographs document participants, equipment preparation, controller use, and waterfront conditions during the North Shore field visit. Companion layouts show mapped imagery and elevation products.
sourceNote: December 1, 2025 camera records and map layouts identify the North Shore visit. Participant roles are credited from project records, not inferred from photographs.

title: Lamont field-trip mapping
description: A SiteScan product from a March 2026 Lamont field trip.
sourceNote: The displayed date comes from the March 4, 2026 SiteScan mission record; it is not a verified individual image-capture time.

title: Hemlock Hill instrumentation and aerial observations
description: SDEV3450 students and WAC partners connected ground measurements with complementary aerial sensors.
sourceNote: Original camera metadata identifies April 15. The terrain display is a photogrammetric processing product, separate from the logged LiDAR acquisition. Paired-camera colors are not calibrated NDVI; the views do not establish agricultural outcomes.

title: Lamont workshop survey and reconstruction
description: The October workshop project includes a DJI survey and a Skydio statue reconstruction. The views document different mission outputs within the same project context.
sourceNote: October 5, 2026 follows the SiteScan workshop mission dates. Mission photo counts are not summed as unique workshop observations.
